mc.item.Item.name: net.minecraft.world.item.Item
mc.item.Item.note: 26.x 物品属性仍用 Item.Properties，但自 1.21.2 起构造前必须 setId(ResourceKey.create(Registries.ITEM, id))，否则启动即报错；ArmorItem/SwordItem/TieredItem 等子类自 1.21.5 起已移除，改用 Properties 上的 sword/pickaxe/humanoidArmor 等配置方法；use 返回 InteractionResult（不再是 InteractionResultHolder）

mc.item.ItemStack.name: net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack
mc.item.ItemStack.note: 26.x 物品数据全面组件化：get/set/update/remove(DataComponents.XXX)，自定义数据用 CustomData；save/parse 自 1.21.6 起已移除，序列化改用 ItemStack.CODEC / OPTIONAL_CODEC 配合 ValueOutput/ValueInput 或 RegistryOps；26.1 起注册表未就绪时不能构造 ItemStack，许多原返回 ItemStack 的方法改为返回不可变的 ItemStackTemplate

mc.item.ItemBlock.name: net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem
mc.item.ItemBlock.note: BlockItem 构造为 (Block, Item.Properties)，同样需要 Properties#setId；Properties#useBlockDescriptionPrefix 可让翻译键沿用方块前缀

mc.item.CreativeModeTab.name: net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTab
mc.item.CreativeModeTab.note: 自建页签用 Fabric API 的 FabricCreativeModeTab.builder()（旧名 FabricItemGroup）构建并 Registry.register(BuiltInRegistries.CREATIVE_MODE_TAB, ...)；原版页签键在 CreativeModeTabs；向已有页签加物品用 CreativeModeTabEvents.modifyOutputEvent(key)

mc.item.EquipmentSlot.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.EquipmentSlot
mc.item.EquipmentSlot.note: 盔甲槽位由 ArmorType（net.minecraft.world.item.equipment）+ Item.Properties#humanoidArmor 描述；EquipmentSlot 仍用于装备读写与 hurtAndBreak 的槽位重载

mc.block.Block.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block
mc.block.Block.note: 方块属性 BlockBehaviour.Properties 自 1.21.2 起必须 setId(ResourceKey.create(Registries.BLOCK, id))；右键交互拆为 useWithoutItem / useItemOn（1.20.5 起），均返回 InteractionResult

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: 构造需要 (BlockEntityType, BlockPos, BlockState)；自 1.21.6 起持久化改为 loadAdditional(ValueInput) / saveAdditional(ValueOutput)，不再直接收发 CompoundTag；BlockEntityType 用 FabricBlockEntityTypeBuilder 构建（原版构造器为私有）

mc.world.Level.name: net.minecraft.world.level.Level
mc.world.Level.note: isClientSide 字段已私有化，改用 isClientSide() 方法；getDayTime 等昼夜时间 API 在 26.1 被世界时钟（net.minecraft.world.clock）取代

mc.world.ChunkPos.name: net.minecraft.world.level.ChunkPos
mc.world.ChunkPos.note: 26.1 起 ChunkPos 为 record：new ChunkPos(BlockPos) -> ChunkPos.containing(pos)，new ChunkPos(long) -> ChunkPos.unpack(l)，ChunkPos.asLong(...) / 实例 toLong() -> pack(...)；仅保留 (int, int) 构造器

mc.entity.Entity.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity
mc.entity.Entity.note: 世界访问用 level()；受伤逻辑自 1.21.2 起覆写 hurtServer(ServerLevel, DamageSource, float)（hurt 变为 final 且返回 void）；getCommandSenderWorld 自 1.21.6 起已移除

mc.entity.player.Player.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player
mc.entity.player.Player.note: displayClientMessage 在 26.1 已移除：快捷栏上方提示用 sendOverlayMessage(Component)，普通聊天消息用 sendSystemMessage(Component)

mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.name: net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer
mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.note: serverLevel() 自 1.21.6 起已移除：ServerPlayer#level() 直接返回 ServerLevel；server 字段已私有，取服务器用 level().getServer()

mc.entity.EntityType.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType
mc.entity.EntityType.note: EntityType.Builder.of(工厂, MobCategory)...build(ResourceKey<EntityType<?>>)：自 1.21.2 起 build 参数为 ResourceKey；spawn/create 的附加数据参数是 Consumer 回调

mc.resources.ResourceLocation.name: net.minecraft.resources.Identifier
mc.resources.ResourceLocation.note: 1.21.11 起官方名 ResourceLocation 改名为 Identifier（同包），API 不变：Identifier.fromNamespaceAndPath(ns, path)、Identifier.parse("ns:path")、Identifier.withDefaultNamespace(path)，构造器私有

mc.nbt.CompoundTag.name: net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag
mc.nbt.CompoundTag.note: 1.21.5 起取值方法返回 Optional（getInt/getString/getCompound/getList…），需要默认值时用 getIntOr/getStringOr 等，嵌套标签用 getCompoundOrEmpty/getListOrEmpty；putUUID/getUUID/hasUUID 已移除，改用 store/read 配合 UUIDUtil.CODEC

mc.nbt.ListTag.name: net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag
mc.nbt.ListTag.note: 1.21.5 起取值方法返回 Optional（getCompound(i) 等），带默认值版本为 getCompoundOrEmpty(i) / getIntOr(i, 默认)

mc.chat.Component.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.Component
mc.chat.Component.note: 工厂方法 Component.literal / translatable 不变；append 定义在 MutableComponent 上

mc.chat.ClickEvent.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.ClickEvent
mc.chat.ClickEvent.note: 1.21.5 起 ClickEvent 是接口，各动作是 record：new ClickEvent.OpenUrl(URI)、new ClickEvent.RunCommand(String)、new ClickEvent.SuggestCommand(String)、new ClickEvent.CopyToClipboard(String) 等，旧的 (Action, String) 构造不可用

mc.chat.HoverEvent.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.HoverEvent
mc.chat.HoverEvent.note: 1.21.5 起 HoverEvent 是接口，各动作是 record：new HoverEvent.ShowText(Component)、new HoverEvent.ShowItem(ItemStackTemplate)、new HoverEvent.ShowEntity(...)，旧的 (Action, 值) 构造不可用

mc.util.InteractionResult.name: net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult
mc.util.InteractionResult.note: 1.21.2 起 InteractionResult 是密封接口：常量 SUCCESS / SUCCESS_SERVER / CONSUME / FAIL / PASS / TRY_WITH_EMPTY_HAND；Item#use 直接返回它（InteractionResultHolder 已移除），需要返回物品时用 InteractionResult.SUCCESS.heldItemTransformedTo(stack)

mc.damage.DamageSource.name: net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource
mc.damage.DamageSource.note: 伤害源数据驱动：level.damageSources().generic() 等，自定义类型用 ResourceKey<DamageType>；实体受伤覆写 hurtServer

mc.effect.MobEffectInstance.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectInstance
mc.effect.MobEffectInstance.note: 构造签名为 MobEffectInstance(Holder<MobEffect>, ...)，MobEffects 常量本身即 Holder

mc.effect.MobEffects.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffects
mc.effect.MobEffects.note: 常量类型为 Holder<MobEffect>，可直接传给 MobEffectInstance 与 hasEffect/getEffect

mc.enchant.Enchantment.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantment
mc.enchant.Enchantment.note: 附魔数据驱动（1.21 起）：定义写 data/<ns>/enchantment/*.json，代码侧用 ResourceKey/Holder<Enchantment>

mc.enchant.Enchantments.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantments
mc.enchant.Enchantments.note: 常量是 ResourceKey<Enchantment>：取 Holder 用 level.registryAccess().lookupOrThrow(Registries.ENCHANTMENT).getOrThrow(key)

mc.enchant.EnchantmentHelper.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.EnchantmentHelper
mc.enchant.EnchantmentHelper.note: 等级查询 getItemEnchantmentLevel(Holder<Enchantment>, ItemInstance)（26.1 参数类型为 ItemInstance，ItemStack 与 ItemStackTemplate 均实现）

mc.syncher.SynchedEntityData.name: net.minecraft.network.syncher.SynchedEntityData
mc.syncher.SynchedEntityData.note: 初始化覆写 defineSynchedData(SynchedEntityData.Builder builder) 并 builder.define(KEY, 默认值)

mc.sound.SoundEvent.name: net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent
mc.sound.SoundEvent.note: SoundEvent 是 record：SoundEvent.createVariableRangeEvent(Identifier) / createFixedRangeEvent(Identifier, float)，注册用 Registry.register(BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT, id, event)

mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.name: net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu
mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.note: 需注册 MenuType（Registry.register(BuiltInRegistries.MENU, ...)）；带开屏数据时用 Fabric API 的 ExtendedMenuType + ExtendedMenuProvider（旧名 ExtendedScreenHandlerType/Factory）

mc.client.Minecraft.name: net.minecraft.client.Minecraft
mc.client.Minecraft.note: 单例 Minecraft.getInstance()；font 字段、setScreen 在 26.1 仍在 Minecraft 上（26.2 起移到 Minecraft#gui）

mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: 26.1 GUI 管线改为「状态提取」：render -> extractRenderState(GuiGraphicsExtractor, int, int, float)，renderBackground -> extractBackground；输入回调自 1.21.9 起为 keyPressed(KeyEvent)、mouseClicked(MouseButtonEvent, boolean) 等事件对象形式

mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen
mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.note: 26.1：renderBg -> extractBackground，renderLabels -> extractLabels，renderSlot -> extractSlot，renderTooltip -> extractTooltip，首参均为 GuiGraphicsExtractor；绑定界面用 MenuScreens.register(type, MyScreen::new)（Fabric API 已放开访问权限）

mc.client.KeyMapping.name: net.minecraft.client.KeyMapping
mc.client.KeyMapping.note: 1.21.9 起分类不再是字符串：构造为 new KeyMapping("key.modid.x", InputConstants.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_R, KeyMapping.Category)，自定义分类用 KeyMapping.Category.register(Identifier)；注册用 Fabric API 的 KeyMappingHelper.registerKeyMapping

mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer
mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.note: 1.21.9 起改为渲染状态模式：createRenderState() + extractRenderState(方块实体, 状态, ...) + submit(状态, PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, CameraRenderState)，旧的 render(T, float, PoseStack, MultiBufferSource, int, int) 已不存在，需人工重写；注册用 Fabric API 的 BlockEntityRendererRegistry.register(type, MyRenderer::new)（原版 BlockEntityRenderers.register 为私有）

mc.client.gui.GuiGraphics.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor
mc.client.gui.GuiGraphics.note: 26.1 起官方名 GuiGraphics 改名为 GuiGraphicsExtractor，多数绘制方法改名：drawString -> text，drawCenteredString -> centeredText，drawWordWrap -> textWithWordWrap，hLine/vLine -> horizontalLine/verticalLine，renderItem -> item，renderFakeItem -> fakeItem，renderItemDecorations -> itemDecorations，renderTooltip -> tooltip，renderOutline -> outline；fill/blit/pose 名称不变

fabric.ModInitializer.name: net.fabricmc.api.ModInitializer
fabric.ModInitializer.note: 主类实现 ModInitializer#onInitialize()，在 fabric.mod.json 的 entrypoints.main 中登记

fabric.ClientModInitializer.name: net.fabricmc.api.ClientModInitializer
fabric.ClientModInitializer.note: 客户端入口 onInitializeClient()，登记在 entrypoints.client

fabric.itemgroup.FabricItemGroup.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.creativetab.v1.FabricCreativeModeTab
fabric.itemgroup.FabricItemGroup.note: 26.1 Fabric API 改用官方名：FabricItemGroup -> FabricCreativeModeTab（包 creativetab.v1），builder() 返回 CreativeModeTab.Builder

fabric.itemgroup.ItemGroupEvents.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.creativetab.v1.CreativeModeTabEvents
fabric.itemgroup.ItemGroupEvents.note: 26.1 改名 CreativeModeTabEvents：modifyEntriesEvent(key) -> modifyOutputEvent(key)，MODIFY_ENTRIES_ALL -> MODIFY_OUTPUT_ALL，回调参数类型为 FabricCreativeModeTabOutput

fabric.registry.FabricRegistryBuilder.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.registry.FabricRegistryBuilder
fabric.registry.FabricRegistryBuilder.note: 26.1 起 createSimple(key) 改名为 create(key)；createDefaulted 不变

fabric.loot.LootTableEvents.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.loot.v3.LootTableEvents
fabric.loot.LootTableEvents.note: 26.1 起 loot v2 模块已删除，只剩 v3：LootTableEvents.MODIFY.register((key, tableBuilder, source, registries) -> ...)，key 为 ResourceKey<LootTable>

fabric.event.ServerTickEvents.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.lifecycle.v1.ServerTickEvents
fabric.event.ServerTickEvents.note: 26.1 起 START_WORLD_TICK/END_WORLD_TICK 改名为 START_LEVEL_TICK/END_LEVEL_TICK；服务器级 START_SERVER_TICK/END_SERVER_TICK 不变

fabric.event.ClientTickEvents.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.event.lifecycle.v1.ClientTickEvents
fabric.event.ClientTickEvents.note: 26.1 起 START_WORLD_TICK/END_WORLD_TICK 改名为 START_LEVEL_TICK/END_LEVEL_TICK

fabric.event.ServerEntityEvents.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.lifecycle.v1.ServerEntityEvents
fabric.event.ServerEntityEvents.note: ENTITY_LOAD / ENTITY_UNLOAD，对应 Forge 的 EntityJoinLevelEvent 等

fabric.event.UseBlockCallback.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.player.UseBlockCallback
fabric.event.UseBlockCallback.note: 回调返回 InteractionResult，PASS 表示不拦截；26.1 另有 BlockEvents.USE_ITEM_ON / USE_WITHOUT_ITEM 可选

fabric.event.UseItemCallback.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.player.UseItemCallback
fabric.event.UseItemCallback.note: 回调签名 interact(Player, Level, InteractionHand) 返回 InteractionResult（不再是 InteractionResultHolder）

fabric.event.WorldRenderEvents.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.rendering.v1.level.LevelRenderEvents
fabric.event.WorldRenderEvents.note: 26.1 改名 LevelRenderEvents（包 rendering.v1.level），阶段常量随渲染管线重排：AFTER_ENTITIES/BEFORE_ENTITIES/BEFORE_TRANSLUCENT 等已不存在，现有 START_MAIN、AFTER_OPAQUE_TERRAIN、COLLECT_SUBMITS、AFTER_SOLID_FEATURES、BEFORE_TRANSLUCENT_TERRAIN、AFTER_TRANSLUCENT_FEATURES、BEFORE_BLOCK_OUTLINE、END_MAIN 等，需人工选择阶段

fabric.network.ServerPlayNetworking.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.networking.v1.ServerPlayNetworking
fabric.network.ServerPlayNetworking.note: CustomPacketPayload 形态：send(serverPlayer, payload)、registerGlobalReceiver(MyPayload.TYPE, (payload, context) -> ...)；26.1 起 createS2CPacket 改名 createClientboundPacket

fabric.network.PacketByteBufs.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.networking.v1.FriendlyByteBufs
fabric.network.PacketByteBufs.note: 26.1 改名 FriendlyByteBufs；正规写法仍是 CustomPacketPayload + StreamCodec，很少需要手工创建缓冲区

fabric.screen.ExtendedScreenHandlerFacto.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.menu.v1.ExtendedMenuProvider
fabric.screen.ExtendedScreenHandlerFacto.note: 26.1 改名 ExtendedMenuProvider<D>（包 menu.v1）：覆写 D getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayer)；配套类型 ExtendedMenuType（原 ExtendedScreenHandlerType）

fabric.screen.HandledScreens.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.MenuScreens
fabric.screen.HandledScreens.note: 原版类官方名 MenuScreens：客户端入口中 MenuScreens.register(MY_MENU_TYPE, MyScreen::new)（Fabric API 通过传递式访问放宽开放该方法）

fabric.client.ColorProviderRegistry.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.rendering.v1.BlockColorRegistry
fabric.client.ColorProviderRegistry.note: 26.1 起 ColorProviderRegistry 被 BlockColorRegistry 取代且只管方块：BlockColorRegistry.register(List<BlockTintSource>, blocks...)，旧的 ColorProviderRegistry.BLOCK.register(provider, blocks) 需人工改写为 BlockTintSource；物品着色自 1.21.4 起由物品模型定义的 tints 负责，ColorProviderRegistry.ITEM 无对应物

fabric.datagen.FabricDataOutput.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.datagen.v1.FabricPackOutput
fabric.datagen.FabricDataOutput.note: 26.1 改名 FabricPackOutput；各 Provider 同步改为官方名（FabricTagProvider -> FabricTagsProvider、FabricBlockLootTableProvider -> FabricBlockLootSubProvider、FabricRecipeExporter -> FabricRecipeOutput 等）

mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.player.PlayerSkin
mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.note: 1.21.9 起 PlayerSkin 从 net.minecraft.client.resources 移到 net.minecraft.world.entity.player；皮肤贴图由 skin.texture() 改为 skin.body().texturePath()

fabric.client.FluidRenderHandler.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.render.fluid.v1.FluidRenderHandler
fabric.client.FluidRenderHandler.note: 26.1/26.2 发布源码：renderFluid 接收 FluidRenderer 与 FluidRenderer.Output；旧 getFluidSprites/getFluidColor/reloadTextures 不再在本接口声明。仅登记类身份，旧实现须结合 FluidModel 手工迁移。

fabric.client.FluidRenderingRegistry.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.render.fluid.v1.FluidRenderingRegistry
fabric.client.FluidRenderingRegistry.note: 仅登记本版本真实类；新旧 Registry 的接收者、静态性及参数不同，跨边界使用独立 IR 与 guidance，不自动类改名。
